bead.title: providers: govern OpenRouter credit probe (SD-013 amendment or ADR-011 extension)
bead.description: AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. service_openrouter_credit.go (17 KB, last touched 2026-05-17) implements credit-balance probing, freshness, and quota-pool gating with no governing SD/ADR. Either amend SD-013 (provider signal matrix) to document the credit probe as a routing-evidence signal, or extend ADR-011 (cost-based routing with quota pools).
bead.acceptance: SD-013 OR ADR-011 contains a section describing: freshness semantics, gating threshold (DefaultOpenrouterCreditBalanceThresholdUSD), failure-mode classification (credential_invalid vs provider_unreachable), and quota-pool integration. No code change required.
